english:
Grants <pve 20% /> <pvp [10%] /> increased Weapon damage for 10 seconds. Also increases <solar Golden Gun /> damage.

Duration can be extended to a maximum of 15 seconds by default. Reapplying <solar Radiant /> refreshes its duration to its longest achieved duration.

The damage bonus increases to 30% against Champions. <solar Well of Radiance /> overrides this with its 25% bonus.

source.text:
Increases Weapon Damage by 20% [10%] for 10 seconds and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
Also affects Golden Gun's Damage.

Reapplying Radiant will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration.

Damage Buff effect is increased to 30% against Champions. Well of Radiance's 25% overrides the 30% against Champions.
